Microsoft (MSFT) vs NVIDIA (NVDA): on the same formula, their operating margins are 13.6 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — MSFT: $331.8B · NVDA: $215.9B
• Revenue growth — MSFT: +17.8% · NVDA: +65.5%
• Operating margin — MSFT: 46.8% · NVDA: 60.4%
• Net margin — MSFT: 40.3% · NVDA: 55.6%
• Free cash flow margin — MSFT: 20.2% · NVDA: 44.8%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — MSFT: 13.7% · NVDA: 68.3%

Different fiscal years: MSFT Jun 30, 2026 · NVDA Jan 25, 2026. The periods are not identical.
